concepts.name: GEOSPATIAL INFORMATION AND DATA PROCESSI
concepts.simple_definition: GEOSPATIAL INFORMATION AND DATA PROCESSING UNIT EIGHT 179 operate on scales of hundreds or thousands of years and for most applications (except geophysics) we can safely omit time from the representation of elevation
concepts.deep_explanation: On the other hand, temperature changes daily and dramatic changes sometimes occur in minutes with the passage of a cold front or thunderstorm, so time is very important

concepts.common_confusion: Students sometimes confuse GEOSPATIAL INFORMATION AND DATA PROCESSI with adjacent topics in Chapter 6.
